tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Retrieve FootballPricer historical verified calibration track record (ROI%, CLV%, and Brier Score vs sharp closing market). Public and free (0 credits). Call this first to audit oracle calibration.

tools.name: list_upcoming_edges
tools.description: List pre-computed upcoming football matches in EPL, Serie A, La Liga, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, and UCL. Use detail="discovery" (0 credits) to browse fixtures & stability, or detail="full" (1 credit / $0.01) to include top +EV picks and offered odds.

tools.name: get_match_pricing
tools.description: Get compact calibrated probabilities (1X2, Asian Handicap, Goals O/U, BTTS), fair odds, EV%, Fractional Kelly sizing, and stability flags. Costs 5 credits ($0.05) on pre-warmed cache hit, or 50 credits ($0.50) if allowFreshRun=true triggers a cold pipeline run (auto-refunded on failure).

tools.name: get_pricing_job
tools.description: Poll an asynchronous cold pricing job started by get_match_pricing. Free (0 credits).

tools.name: reprice_live_odds
tools.description: Deterministic <10ms Dixon-Coles re-pricer (1 credit / $0.01). Default mode="quote_only" evaluates live Polymarket/Kalshi probability shares (0.01..0.99) or decimal odds against fixed model probabilities with slippage & commission without distorting the sharp prior. Use mode="reanchor_market" for sha
